description_en: Retrieves the parameter settings of a gateway
name: GetGatewayConfig

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The response code that is synchronized with the Success parameter

DownstreamConnectionBufferLimits.description_en: Applies to gateway connections. The buffer size per connection. This setting affects throughput and gateway memory usage. Unit: bytes
DownstreamConnectionBufferLimits.description_zh: 作用于网关连接，单条链接的buffer大小，配置后会影响吞吐和网关的内存使用（单位：Byte）

DownstreamHttp2MaxConcurrentStream.description_en: Applies to the request phase. The maximum number of concurrent streams on a single connection when the client uses HTTP/2
DownstreamHttp2MaxConcurrentStream.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，客户端使用http2时一条链接上最大并发数

DownstreamIdleTime.description_en: Applies to gateway connections. The connection between the client and the gateway is closed if no request is received within the specified period
DownstreamIdleTime.description_zh: 作用于网关连接，客户端到网关处于指定的时间内没有请求，则会断开链接
DownstreamIdleTime.title_en: 客户端到网关处于指定的时间内[0-600]没有请求，则会断开链接
DownstreamIdleTime.title_zh: 客户端到网关处于指定的时间内[0-600]没有请求，则会断开链接

EnableCustomAuthConfigPush.description_en: Applies to scenarios that use a self-managed authentication service. When enabled, changes to authentication rules do not cause connection interruptions. This is suitable for WebSocket and online business scenarios
EnableCustomAuthConfigPush.description_zh: 作用于使用自建的鉴权服务的场景，开启后鉴权规则变更不会引起连接中断，适用于WebSocket和在线业务场景

EnableGenerateRequestId.description_en: Applies to the request scope. When enabled, a request ID is generated in the request header for request tracing
EnableGenerateRequestId.description_zh: 作用于请求范围，根据配置会在请求头中生成requestId，以便追踪请求

EnableGzip.description_en: Applies to the request and response phases. Enabling gzip compresses request and response data, which reduces gateway traffic but increases gateway CPU consumption
EnableGzip.description_zh: 作用于请求与响应环节，启用gzip会对请求响应进行压缩，会减少网关流量，增加网关cpu消耗

EnableHardwareAccelerate.description_en: Specifies whether to enable hardware acceleration. This may fail if your region does not support it at the infrastructure level or if hardware acceleration was not specified at purchase time
EnableHardwareAccelerate.description_zh: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)
EnableHardwareAccelerate.title_en: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)
EnableHardwareAccelerate.title_zh: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)

EnableHttp2.description_en: Applies to the request phase. Specifies whether to use HTTP/2 during negotiation between the server and client. Changes take effect within 1 to 2 minutes
EnableHttp2.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，服务端与客户端协商时是否使用http2（修改后1～2分钟后生效）

EnableProxyProtocol.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the Proxy protocol. If the gateway ingress traffic is received through NLB, the originating IP address of the client cannot be obtained without enabling this protocol. Enabling it does not affect non-Proxy protocol requests
EnableProxyProtocol.description_zh: 是否开启Proxy协议，如果网关入口流量使用NLB接入，如果不开启则无法获取客户端的真实IP，开启后对于非Proxy协议请求没有影响

EnableSlashMerge.description_en: Applies to the request phase. Specifies whether to merge redundant slashes in requests. When enabled, redundant slashes in www.a.com//b are merged, making it equivalent to www.a.com/b
EnableSlashMerge.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，是否合并请求中多余的‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致
EnableSlashMerge.title_en: 是否合并‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致
EnableSlashMerge.title_zh: 是否合并‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

InitialConnectionWindowSize.description_en: Applies to the request phase. The connection-level initial window size negotiated between the gateway and the client when using HTTP/2. Unit: bytes
InitialConnectionWindowSize.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关同客户端使用http2时连接级别初始窗口大小（单位：Byte）
InitialConnectionWindowSize.title_en: http2  连接 初始窗口大小
InitialConnectionWindowSize.title_zh: http2  连接 初始窗口大小

InitialStreamWindowSize.description_en: Applies to the request phase. The initial stream window size negotiated between the gateway and the client when using HTTP/2. Unit: bytes
InitialStreamWindowSize.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关同客户端使用http2时协商的stream初始窗口大小（单位：Byte）
InitialStreamWindowSize.title_en: http2  stream 初始窗口大小
InitialStreamWindowSize.title_zh: http2  stream 初始窗口大小

KeepaliveHeaderTimeout.description_en: Specifies the value used to generate the Keep-Alive response header returned to the client, indicating the connection keep-alive time. For example, if set to 10, the response header `keep-alive: timeout=10` is returned. If set to 0, this response header is not returned
KeepaliveHeaderTimeout.description_zh: 用于生成Keep-Alive响应头返回给客户端，告知连接的保活时间。例如配置为10时，会返回响应头: `keep-alive: timeout=10`。配置为0时，不会返回该响应头

PathWithEscapedSlashes.description_en:
Specifies the action for requests that contain escaped characters %2F, %2f, %5C, or %5c in the URI path. The default value is KEEP_UNCHANGED.

Valid values:

KEEP_UNCHANGED

REJECT_REQUEST

UNESCAPE_AND_REDIRECT

UNESCAPE_AND_FORWARD
PathWithEscapedSlashes.description_zh:
确定 URI 路径中包含 %2F、%2f、%5C 或 %5c 这些转义的请求的操作, 默认为KEEP_UNCHANGED(保持不变)

取值：

KEEP_UNCHANGED

REJECT_REQUEST

UNESCAPE_AND_REDIRECT

UNESCAPE_AND_FORWARD

PreserveHeaderFormat.description_en: Applies to the request and response phases. Specifies whether to preserve the original case of request headers. In the HTTP/1.1 specification, headers are case-insensitive. For HTTP/2 compatibility, headers are converted to lowercase by default
PreserveHeaderFormat.description_zh: 作用于请求和响应环节，是否保持请求header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写
PreserveHeaderFormat.title_en: 是否保持header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写
PreserveHeaderFormat.title_zh: 是否保持header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

LogOn.description_en: Indicates whether log delivery is enabled

LogStoreName.description_en:
The destination Logstore for log delivery. Valid values:

If Nginx Ingress compatibility is not enabled: mse_gw_access_log

If Nginx Ingress compatibility is enabled: nginx-ingress
LogStoreName.description_zh:
日志投递目标Logstore，取值：

未开启兼容Nginx Ingress：mse_gw_access_log

开启兼容Nginx Ingress：nginx-ingress

NginxCompatible.description_en: Indicates whether Nginx Ingress compatibility is enabled
NginxCompatible.description_zh: 是否开启兼容 Nginx Ingress

ProjectName.description_en: The destination project for log delivery

SupportWaf.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports WAF

UpstreamIdleTimeout.description_en: The default idle timeout for upstream connections

WebsocketTermGracePeriod.description_en: The keep-alive time maintained for WebSocket connections when the gateway instance needs to close connections during upgrades or restarts. Unit: seconds
WebsocketTermGracePeriod.description_zh: 当网关实例升级、重启等需要关闭连接的场景下，为Websocket连接维持的保活时间（单位：s）

XffTrustedNum.description_en: Applies to the request phase. The number of trusted proxies in front of the gateway. This affects whether the gateway uses client-generated request headers such as x-forwarded-for and x-request-id
XffTrustedNum.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关前可信任的代理个数，会影响网关是否会使用客户端产生的x-forwarded-for和x-request-id等请求头
XffTrustedNum.title_en: 网关前可信任的设备个数
XffTrustedNum.title_zh: 网关前可信任的设备个数

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the Tracing Analysis information was created
GmtCreate.description_zh: 链路追踪信息创建时间

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the Tracing Analysis information was last modified
GmtModified.description_zh: 链路追踪信息修改时间

ServiceId.description_en: The Skywalking service ID for self-managed Skywalking

ServicePort.description_en: The Skywalking service port for self-managed Skywalking

TraceOn.description_en: Indicates whether Tracing Analysis is enabled

TraceType.description_en:
The Tracing Analysis type. Valid values:

XTRACE: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the Zipkin tracing protocol.

SKYWALKING: Self-managed Skywalking.

OPENTELEMETRY: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the OpenTelemetry tracing protocol.

OTSKYWALKING: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the Skywalking tracing protocol
TraceType.description_zh:
链路追踪类型：

XTRACE：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议Zipkin

SKYWALKING：自建Skywalking

OPENTELEMETRY：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议OpenTelemetry

OTSKYWALKING：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议Skywalking

ZipAlgorithm.description_en: The compression algorithm used when compression is enabled. You can select brotli or gzip. If EnableGzip is not enabled, it is automatically enabled when this parameter is set
ZipAlgorithm.description_zh: 开启压缩后使用的算法，可以选择brotli，gzip，如果此时EnableGzip未开启，将自动开启EnableGzip选项

DynamicCode.description_en: Not in use. Ignore this parameter
DynamicCode.title_en: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符

DynamicMessage.description_en: Not in use. Ignore this parameter

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
`true`: The request was successful.
`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
